# proxmox_qemu_agent_fsfreeze_status (Data Source)

Reads the guest filesystem freeze state through `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/agent/fsfreeze-status`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_qemu_agent_fsfreeze_status" "f" {
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `frozen` (Boolean)
